rationale: All examples erase colour 6 to background 8, preserve anchors 1, and paint 7 after three quarter-turns. In the first demonstration, (5,5) rotates around (8,5) to (8,2), while (8,8) rotates around (8,11) to (11,11). Global one-to-one assignment gives the midpoint source the right anchor instead of reusing the left anchor.
